verdict.rationale: Better Auth's API Key plugin lets backend services and agents authenticate requests without a human, with verification, expiration, rate limiting and refill controls. That covers machine-to-machine auth in spirit. The marketing claims 'Auth for AI agents… token exchange, and agent delegation', and the MCP plugin makes the app an OAuth authorization server, but no evidence documents an OAuth client-credentials grant specifically. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented client_credentials grant (client ID/secret exchanged for an access token), machine-client registration and management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent/M2M token issuance.
